qa_pairs.question: What engine designation is used for the BMW M3 according to this service manual?
qa_pairs.answer: The BMW M3 uses Engine S 14 Z.

qa_pairs.question: On which page can I find information about compression checking for all cylinders?
qa_pairs.answer: Compression of all cylinders - check can be found on page 11-51.

qa_pairs.question: What is the page reference for cylinder head sealing surface procedures when the cylinder head is disassembled?
qa_pairs.answer: Cylinder head sealing surface (cylinder head disassembled) procedures are on page 11-55.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find the procedure for replacing the crankshaft main bearing shells with the engine disassembled?
qa_pairs.answer: The procedure for replacing crankshaft main bearing shells (engine disassembled) is found on page 11-61b.

qa_pairs.question: What service procedure is listed under section 11 14 141?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 11 14 141 covers radial oil seal in lower timing case cover - replace.

qa_pairs.question: On which page would I find information about starter gear ring replacement?
qa_pairs.answer: Starter gear ring replacement information is on page 11-63.
